# Targeted mirrored reads for replica cache warming

# Targeted mirrored reads for replica cache warming — concept pack

## Vocabulary

Terms this pack was harvested with, grouped by their relation to the concept; counts are units matched / sources. Zero-hit terms are listed under Coverage. On every unit line, `keywords:` names the terms that matched.

- **self**: Targeted mirrored reads for replica cache warming (16/3)

## How it works

- [statement] A historical MongoDB proposal describes hiding a restarted cold member while warming it and leaving enablement and later unhide decisions to an external mechanism. Treat this as motivation for an operator-controlled warming workflow, not evidence of automatic cache-readiness detection or automatic unhiding. (low confidence) — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-79660 · keywords: Targeted mirrored reads for replica cache warming
- [statement] The upstream v8.2 implementation caches destinations by matching replica-set member tags. It refreshes the list when configuration version/term or the configured target tag changes, and defers computation if replica-set configuration is uninitialized. (low confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/v8.2/src/mongo/db/mirror_maestro.cpp · keywords: Targeted mirrored reads for replica cache warming

## How-to and procedures

- [statement] Configure mirrorReads.targetedMirroring.tag as one key/value document, for example {warm:'standby'}. Only one tag is accepted; matching members in the same replica set are targeted. Use the nested tag document, not historical tagKey/tagValue proposal syntax. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/parameters.md · keywords: Targeted mirrored reads for replica cache warming · also: https://minervadb.com/mongodb-8-3-high-availability-and-scalability/

## Measurements and reference values

- [statement] The targetedMirroring subdocument has its own samplingRate and maxTimeMS. The documented sampling range is 0.0–1.0, default 0.01; timeout defaults to 1000 ms. Targeted mirroring is off by default because tag is empty. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/parameters.md · keywords: Targeted mirrored reads for replica cache warming

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] In the MongoDB 8.2 implementation, mirroredReads.targetedSent counts targeted network requests scheduled for sending, while targetedErroredDuringSend counts send errors. Successful-completion counters are exposed only under a test failpoint, so targetedSent alone cannot prove a warm cache. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-27) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/v8.2/src/mongo/db/mirror_maestro.cpp · keywords: Targeted mirrored reads for replica cache warming

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Mirrored reads pre-warm secondary caches with application access patterns to reduce cold-cache performance loss after failover. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/replication.md · keywords: Targeted mirrored reads for replica cache warming · also: https://www.percona.com/blog/mongodb-4-4-coming-out-soon-what-does-the-code-tell-us/
- [statement] MongoDB documents targeted mirrored reads starting in 8.2. Replica-set tags select warming destinations, including hidden members, and targeted mirrors can originate on both primary and secondary nodes; ordinary mirroring targets electable secondaries. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/replication.md · keywords: Targeted mirrored reads for replica cache warming · also: https://minervadb.com/mongodb-8-3-high-availability-and-scalability/, https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-104849
- [statement] The replication manual explicitly permits targeted mirroring from both primary and secondary members. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/replication.md · keywords: Targeted mirrored reads for replica cache warming
- [statement] mirrorReads.targetedMirroring uses one tag key/value pair, targets matching members in the same replica set, and has its own samplingRate and maxTimeMS. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/parameters.md · keywords: Targeted mirrored reads for replica cache warming · also: https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-104849
- [statement] Mirroring runs asynchronously without awaiting mirrored results for the client response; this does not establish zero resource cost. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/replication.md · keywords: Targeted mirrored reads for replica cache warming · also: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/v8.2/src/mongo/db/mirror_maestro.cpp
- [statement] mirrorReadsMaxConnPoolSize controls the mirroring connection pool for both general and targeted modes. The parameter reference identifies it as new in 8.2, with default 4 and minimum 1; increasing mirrored traffic still consumes destination resources. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/parameters.md · keywords: Targeted mirrored reads for replica cache warming · also: https://minervadb.com/mongodb-8-3-high-availability-and-scalability/
- [statement] Cold-cache failover can raise read latency even after a new primary is elected. Alibaba Cloud describes this in ApsaraDB instances whose secondary served no reads; Percona independently explains the resulting disk reads. Mirrored reads aim to warm the working set before promotion, without guaranteeing a fixed recovery time. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/replication.md · keywords: Targeted mirrored reads for replica cache warming · also: https://www.percona.com/blog/mongodb-4-4-coming-out-soon-what-does-the-code-tell-us/, https://help.aliyun.com/en/mongodb/product-overview/features-of-mongodb-4
- [statement] General and targeted mirroring have separate sampling settings. A targeted configuration can supplement general mirroring; do not assume changing only the top-level samplingRate also disables targeted traffic. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/parameters.md · keywords: Targeted mirrored reads for replica cache warming · also: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/v8.2/src/mongo/db/mirror_maestro.cpp, https://minervadb.com/mongodb-8-3-high-availability-and-scalability/
- [statement] Eligible operations include find, count and distinct, plus the filter portions of update and findAndModify. Mirroring those filters warms read paths; it does not replay the writes themselves. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/replication.md · keywords: Targeted mirrored reads for replica cache warming · also: https://minervadb.com/mongodb-8-3-high-availability-and-scalability/
- [statement] Mirrored reads run asynchronously as fire-and-forget requests. The original request does not wait for a mirrored result; the upstream implementation marks mirror requests and avoids mirroring an already mirrored request. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/replication.md · keywords: Targeted mirrored reads for replica cache warming · also: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/v8.2/src/mongo/db/mirror_maestro.cpp
- [statement] Inspect mirroring with db.serverStatus({mirroredReads:1}). In the inspected v8.2 implementation, targetedSent and targetedErroredDuringSend are exposed normally, while targetedResolved, targetedSucceeded and targetedResolvedBreakdown require mirrorMaestroExpectsResponse; pending/scheduled fields require mirrorMaestroTracksPending. Do not promise these test counters as normal production telemetry. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/replication.md · keywords: Targeted mirrored reads for replica cache warming · also: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/v8.2/src/mongo/db/mirror_maestro.cpp
